description.value: Scheduled water taxi running year-round from Lund to Savary Island and surrounding areas including Sarah Point (Sunshine Coast Trail start) and Desolation Sound. Regular bikes carried for $4 each way; e-bikes banned from the water taxi (barge only, by special arrangement).
